findings.message: The type tatpuruṣa is correct and the meaning ('best among the best') is right. The vigraha उत्तमानाम् उत्तमः uses a genitive of selection (nirdhāraṇa), and Pāṇini 2.2.10 (na nirdhāraṇe) forbids a ṣaṣṭhī tatpuruṣa from such a genitive. Grammarians usually explain -uttama compounds like puruṣottama as saptamī tatpuruṣa, using the locative of selection allowed by 2.3.41 (e.g. puruṣeṣu uttamaḥ). The meaning does not change, so this is a flag, not a fail.
findings.suggested_fix: subtype: "saptamī", vigraha: "उत्तमेषु उत्तमः, तम्" (or keep ṣaṣṭhī and add a note on 2.2.10)
